content.summary: The root-selection repair and two constructive reformulations are supported by bounded independent checks. The scalar and cover interfaces retain their necessary geometric hypotheses, including proper-trace multiplicity. No further repair is required in these scopes. Imported-theorem and full-replay limitations remain; both frozen hashes match.

findings.statement: A compact scalar lemma and canonical cover charging give valid alternative explanations of existing interfaces.
findings.disposition: These are optional formulations of already supplied arguments, not missing mathematical obligations or requests to strengthen the theorem.

revisions.action: Rechecked constructive formulations against the prior adverse controls.
revisions.result: The root cases retain maximum-degree selection; cover charging allows two proper-trace completions. No previously identified guard was weakened.

revisions.action: Executed only the bounded calculations described below.
revisions.result: No large tree, complete cover package, solver or compiler replay was performed; assurance remains scoped.

checks.scope: Alternative scalar formulation of the empty-internal P10 contradiction
checks.method: Reassess D17-P10-ordinary-closure.md and enumerate all 6648 nonnegative H,P,E signatures with P<=18 and H+2P+3E<=60.
checks.observation: Put u=N-m-h, where m is root degree and h bounds intersecting pools. The existing geometry gives u<=P+E and 10u<=5H+8P+10E. The exact maximum permitted u is23. Algebraically, u>=24 implies E>=u-18 and 10u<=354-5u, impossible. Thus N<=m+h+23 summarizes this interface; N=68,h=27,m=17 violates it. Empty internal family remains essential to the incidence60 premise, preserving the earlier internal-cost distinction.

checks.scope: Constructive validation of the maximum-degree root repair
checks.method: Compare manuscript Section 5.2 with R15-rho6-finite-closure.md; enumerate all 3003 five-edge and 5005 six-edge graphs on six padded vertices under degree<=2 and matching<=2.
checks.observation: Five-edge survivors are exactly 72 labelled C5 graphs and 60 triangle-plus-two-edge-path graphs; six-edge survivors are exactly 10 pairs of disjoint triangles. The six-vertex domain follows from path/cycle components and matching<=2. The manuscript chooses degree 6 whenever present, so global cap 5 is used only when no degree 6 point exists. This independently supports the repaired normalization; it does not rerun the subsequent eleven-point trees.

checks.scope: Canonical cover charging with both Q8 leaves shared
checks.method: Read LOW15-A3-cover-independent-bridge.md and directly enumerate all 121 deletion sets for Q8 with core 0–4 and leaves 10,11, joined to H7 shifted by 5.
checks.observation: This valid 15-triple model has support 12 and maximum point degree 5. Raw cover maxima are 2,4,8. Assigning a four-cover to its first contained C3, or otherwise itself in P4, justifies the union bound without assuming disjoint generators. Deleting {6,7,9} and {6,8,9} produces C3={0,1,5}; its completions {0,1,5,100} and {0,1,5,101} both cover the remaining link. Triple codegree permits at most two actual completions, while simplicity handles P4. The check retains exterior multiplicity and covers one shared-leaf model, not all 21 models.
